meta_description: Automated Dollar Cost Averaging for Bitcoin and crypto. Self-custody, open source, 7 exchanges supported.
hero_subtitle: Own your DCA. Bitcoin accumulation that runs on your phone — no cloud, no middlemen. Just you and your exchange.
value_custody_desc: Your API keys never leave your device. Encrypted with AES-256-GCM via Android Keystore. No cloud, no tracking.
value_auto_desc: Configure once, accumulate forever. AccBot executes purchases on your schedule, even when your phone is in your pocket.
value_open_desc: Fully auditable code under MIT license. No hidden fees, no premium tiers, no data collection. Free forever.
features_strategies_desc: Choose from three strategies to optimize your accumulation. Classic DCA buys a fixed amount every time. ATH-based increases purchases when price drops below all-time high. Fear & Greed adjusts based on market sentiment.
features_strategies_ath_desc: 0.5x near ATH, up to 3x at 70%+ below
features_strategies_fg_desc: 0.25x at extreme greed, 2.5x at extreme fear
features_portfolio_desc: Track your holdings, ROI, and performance with interactive charts. See your cost basis, current value, and returns across all exchanges and trading pairs.
features_history_desc: Complete history of every DCA purchase with filtering by crypto, exchange, and status. Export to CSV for tax reporting or your own analysis.
features_sandbox_desc: Test your strategies risk-free with exchange testnet environments. Sandbox uses a separate database so your production data stays safe.
features_withdrawal_desc: Automatically send purchased crypto to your own wallet address after each purchase. True self-custody.
features_qr_desc: Scan your API keys and wallet addresses with your camera. No more error-prone manual entry of long alphanumeric strings.
exchanges_subtitle: Connect to any of 7 major exchanges. Create multiple DCA plans across different exchanges and trading pairs.
security_subtitle: AccBot is built on a decentralized, security-first architecture. Your data stays on your device.
security_aes_desc: API credentials encrypted with hardware-backed Android Keystore
security_local_desc: No data is ever uploaded to any server
security_direct_desc: Communication goes directly to exchanges via HTTPS
security_biometric_desc: Optional fingerprint or face recognition to open the app
security_opensource_desc: Fully auditable codebase under MIT license
security_nocloud_desc: No analytics, no tracking, no ads, no telemetry
howto_step1_desc: Add your exchange API keys with trading-only permissions. Scan QR codes or enter manually.
howto_step2_desc: Set your crypto, amount, frequency, and strategy. Choose from Classic, ATH-based, or Fear & Greed DCA.
howto_step3_desc: AccBot runs in the background and executes purchases on your schedule. Track performance in the portfolio view.
download_subtitle: Available for Android. Free and open source.
privacy_intro: AccBot ("the App") is a self-custody cryptocurrency DCA (Dollar Cost Averaging) tool developed by Crynners. This privacy policy explains how the App handles your data.
privacy_collection_text: AccBot does not collect, transmit, or store any personal data on external servers. All data remains exclusively on your device.
privacy_stored_text: The following data is stored locally on your device only:
privacy_stored_item1: Exchange API credentials (encrypted with AES-256-GCM via Android Keystore)
privacy_stored_item2: DCA plan configurations (crypto pair, amount, frequency, strategy)
privacy_stored_item3: Transaction history (purchase records from your DCA executions)
privacy_stored_item5: Withdrawal history (records of crypto withdrawals to your wallets)
privacy_stored_item6: Exchange balance snapshots (cached account balances for portfolio display)
privacy_stored_item7: Cached market price data (cryptocurrency prices fetched from third-party APIs)
privacy_stored_item8: Notification history (records of app notifications and alerts)
privacy_network_intro: The App communicates with the following external services via HTTPS. All connections are encrypted in transit. No personal data is intentionally sent; however, your device's IP address is exposed to these services as part of normal network communication.
privacy_network_exchanges_text: The App connects directly to exchanges you configure (e.g. Coinmate, Binance, Kraken, KuCoin, Bitfinex, Huobi, Coinbase) to execute trades, retrieve balances, and fetch order data. Only your API credentials and trade parameters are sent.
privacy_network_market_text: The App fetches cryptocurrency prices and market data from CoinGecko (coingecko.com), CryptoCompare (cryptocompare.com), and Alternative.me (alternative.me) for the Fear & Greed Index. No personal data or API credentials are sent to these services — only standard HTTPS requests for public market data.
privacy_network_mlkit_text: The App uses Google ML Kit for barcode scanning and text recognition. ML Kit processes data on-device, but the SDK may send diagnostic data to Google, including device information, app info, per-installation identifiers, and performance metrics. This data is not used for advertising or user profiling. This data collection is managed by Google and is described in Google's Privacy Policy.
privacy_security_text: AccBot employs multiple layers of security to protect your data:
privacy_security_item1: Exchange API credentials are encrypted using AES-256-GCM with keys stored in the hardware-backed Android Keystore
privacy_security_item2: Sensitive app preferences are stored using EncryptedSharedPreferences
privacy_security_item3: All network communication uses HTTPS encryption in transit
privacy_security_item4: All app data is stored in app-private storage, inaccessible to other applications
privacy_security_item5: Optional biometric authentication (fingerprint or face recognition) adds an additional layer of access protection
privacy_security_item6: Exported backups are encrypted with a user-chosen password using AES-256-GCM
privacy_perm_internet: Internet: Required to communicate with exchange APIs for executing trades and fetching market data
privacy_perm_camera: Camera: Used exclusively for scanning QR codes containing API keys or wallet addresses. Camera data is not stored or transmitted.
privacy_perm_battery: Battery optimization exemption: Required for reliable background execution of scheduled DCA purchases
privacy_perm_alarm: Exact alarms: Required for precise scheduling of DCA purchase executions
privacy_perm_foreground: Foreground service: Required to monitor and execute DCA plans in the background
privacy_perm_notifications: Notifications: Used to inform you about DCA execution results, errors, and plan status updates
privacy_perm_network: Network state: Used to check internet connectivity before attempting trade executions
privacy_perm_boot: Boot completed: Allows the App to reschedule DCA plans after device restart
privacy_perm_wakelock: Wake lock: Ensures the device stays awake long enough to complete trade executions
privacy_thirdparty_text: AccBot does not integrate any third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking services. The App communicates with the following third-party services:
privacy_thirdparty_exchanges: Cryptocurrency exchanges (Coinmate, Binance, Kraken, KuCoin, Bitfinex, Huobi, Coinbase) — only those you explicitly connect, for trade execution and balance retrieval
privacy_thirdparty_coingecko: CoinGecko — for cryptocurrency price data and market information
privacy_thirdparty_cryptocompare: CryptoCompare — for cryptocurrency price data and all-time high tracking
privacy_thirdparty_alternative: Alternative.me — for the Fear & Greed Index used in the Fear & Greed DCA strategy
privacy_thirdparty_mlkit: Google ML Kit — on-device barcode scanning and text recognition. ML Kit may collect diagnostic data as described in Google's Privacy Policy. This data is not used for advertising or user profiling.
privacy_deletion_text: AccBot does not require user registration or user accounts. All data can be deleted by using the "Delete All Data" option in Settings, or by uninstalling the App. Since no data is stored externally, uninstallation removes all traces of your data.
privacy_children_text: AccBot is not intended for use by children under 18. The App facilitates cryptocurrency trading which is subject to age restrictions in most jurisdictions.
privacy_biometric_text: AccBot offers an optional biometric lock (fingerprint or face recognition) to protect access to the App. Biometric data is handled entirely by the Android operating system and is never accessed, stored, or transmitted by AccBot. The App only receives a success/failure result from the system biometric prompt.
privacy_backup_text: AccBot allows you to export encrypted backups of your data, including DCA plans, transaction history, and optionally your exchange API credentials. Backup files are encrypted with a password you choose using AES-256-GCM encryption. Backup files are saved to your device's local storage and are never uploaded to any server by the App. You are responsible for the security of exported backup files.
privacy_retention_text: All data is stored locally on your device for as long as the App is installed. There are no server-side retention policies because no data is stored on external servers. You can delete specific data (individual DCA plans, transaction history) within the App, or use "Delete All Data" in Settings to erase everything. Uninstalling the App permanently removes all locally stored data.
privacy_rights_text: Because AccBot stores all data locally on your device and does not collect personal data on any server, you have full control over your data at all times. You can view, export, or delete any data through the App's interface. If you are in the EU (GDPR) or California (CCPA), please note that AccBot does not process personal data on external servers, so typical data subject access requests do not apply. For any privacy concerns, please contact us.
privacy_international_text: When AccBot communicates with cryptocurrency exchanges and market data providers, your requests are sent to servers that may be located in various countries worldwide. These connections are encrypted via HTTPS. AccBot does not control the location of third-party servers. Please review the privacy policies of the exchanges and services you use.
privacy_changes_text: Any changes to this privacy policy will be published in the app's source code repository and reflected on this page.
privacy_contact_text: For questions about this privacy policy or the App, you can reach us at crynners@gmail.com or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
